description:
[read-only] flayr.social's ad tags per network (reddit, tiktok, linkedin, x, google, pinterest, snapchat): saved id, env default, requested, effectively on. Read-only. Site-wide: the connected account must be a flayr super-admin, or its brand must be in FLAYR_SITE_TAG_BRAND_IDS (else ADS_SITE_TAG_NOT_ALLOWED). Needs the ads:manage scope.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/ads/site-tags.)

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand.

name: ads_site_tags_get
title: Read the site ad tags
